item.title: Static Projects
item.description:
Projects of PioterekS 🔧

Below are the projects serverd on https://piotereks.top site.

  • Free Parking (free-parking) — An app that aggregates and visualizes corporate parking availability in Wrocław of Green Day and leased from University () (real-time and historical).This tool was created to fill the gap of original app that is showing numbers but you don’t know if they are up to date. It also help sustainability because having better overview or knowing when usually places end or when they start to get free, you can plan better time, not circulate unecessary. You can see DAshboard and Chart with 2 days history. Run: /free-parking/
